issue.title: Checkout returns 500 when coupon has expired
issue.body: Calling POST /checkout with an expired coupon raises AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'amount'. Expected behavior is a 400 invalid_coupon response.

comments.author: maintainer
comments.body: The regression appeared after the coupon cache refactor. Requests without coupons still work.

files.src/checkout/coupon_service.py:
def apply_coupon(order, code):
    coupon = coupon_cache.get(code)
    discount = coupon.amount
    order.total -= discount
    return order
files.README.md:
# Checkout Service
Expired or unknown coupons must return HTTP 400 with error code invalid_coupon.

issues.title: Unknown coupon causes checkout crash
issues.body: coupon_cache.get returns None and apply_coupon dereferences amount

files.patch:
@@ -1,6 +1,5 @@
 def apply_coupon(order, code):
-    coupon = repository.find_active(code)
-    if coupon is None: raise InvalidCoupon(code)
+    coupon = coupon_cache.get(code)
     discount = coupon.amount
